purpose: Separate semantic relevance from numerical neighbor recall and search-only latency.

semantic.corpus: Unmodified P106 original synthetic 20 Spanish documents
semantic.queries: Unmodified P106 dev10/test10, author-known judgments; no new blind test claim
semantic.input: title + one space + body; query unchanged
semantic.baseline: P106 BM25 fold, k1=1.2 b=.75; same analyzer for corpus/query; no tuning
semantic.dense: 384d mean pooling with attention mask, normalized float32 vectors; cosine exhaustive ranking; all candidates including negative scores
semantic.metrics: P@3 with fixed denominator3, R@3, truncated RR@3, macro over answerable queries separately dev/test; negative query separately
semantic.abstention: None. Do not calibrate a threshold on Q20 or reinterpret similarity as probability.

encoder.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean including unmasked special tokens; no normalization before saving raw vectors
encoder.provenance: Fixed converted ONNX snapshot and hashes, not original full-precision model or API

indexControl.composition: 20 semantic documents plus 980 deterministic original synthetic support records; all genuinely encoded by the same model
indexControl.relevance: No semantic labels for the 980 controls. Their experiment evaluates numerical nearest-neighbor approximation only.
indexControl.reference: FAISS FlatL2 over the same normalized float32 vectors; squared L2
indexControl.insertionOrder: semantic IDs D01..D20, then S0001..S0980; single native thread; native default graph RNG, not an exposed controlled seed
indexControl.annRecall: Intersection of ANN top10 IDs with the stored exact FlatL2 top10 / 10, mean across20 queries. Exact-boundary ties may make set recall sensitive; retain distances and boundary gaps.
indexControl.schedule: round-major, strategies in declared order, queries Q01..Q20; no best-run selection
indexControl.timing: performance.now around synchronous native search only, preencoded inputs, result allocation included; record every request; no end-to-end or concurrency claim
indexControl.pgvector: Separate PostgreSQL run, exact and HNSW cosine with plans verified; pg client query timing includes IPC; never compare it as pure native kernel time

selection: No model selection, tuning, post-result label edits or favorable retry; preserve regressions, unchanged results and negative-query neighbors.
limits: Tiny synthetic corpus and author-known judgments; not a benchmark of models, production scale, user relevance or security. Index control has no semantic gold.
